meta.title: IronGate Solutions modernizes legacy systems with speed

testimonial.author: David Vogt
testimonial.quote: Unmatched precision and bank-grade security. We integrated our legacy systems in hours, not weeks. The API flexibility is simply world-class.

content.text: IronGate Solutions operates in a highly regulated environment where security and reliability are critical. However, their legacy infrastructure made it difficult to integrate modern tools or adapt to evolving business needs.
Traditional integration processes were slow and resource-intensive, limiting the company's ability to innovate and respond quickly.
Legacy systems created significant friction in connecting new technologies.
Integration projects often took weeks to complete and required extensive engineering effort. At the same time, strict security requirements limited flexibility and increased complexity.
The team needed a solution that could bridge old and new systems without compromising performance or security.
IronGate Solutions adopted bigA.i to streamline integration through flexible APIs and automation.

Instead of building custom integrations from scratch, the team used bigA.i to connect systems quickly and securely. Workflows were designed to handle data exchange automatically while maintaining strict compliance standards.
This significantly reduced the time and effort required to modernize their infrastructure.
Integration timelines were reduced dramatically, allowing the company to move faster without sacrificing security.
The team gained the flexibility to adopt new tools while maintaining the integrity of their existing systems.

items: Integration completed in hours instead of weeks

content.text: IronGate Solutions transformed integration from a bottleneck into a competitive advantage.
With bigA.i, they were able to modernize their infrastructure without compromising on security or reliability.
